biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend is genuinely NEW to First Financial, opens a membership with a $5 Base Savings deposit, AND opens a new checking account between 2/17/26 and 12/31/26. Referring an existing member or a business/minor account earns you nothing, and the offer window ends 12/31/26.
catches: Referred friend must be a new member (existing members ineligible for the new-member offer) who opens a membership plus a new checking account between 2/17/26 and 12/31/26; business accounts and accounts for minors under 14 do not qualify.
Coupon for each referral must be completed and returned to the Marketing Department to qualify.
Referring member must have an existing First Financial account in good standing.
New member must keep the account and membership open at least 6 months or their $90 bonus is deducted at closing (friend-side clawback; no clawback stated for the referrer's bonus).
Offer can be canceled or withdrawn at any time; cannot be combined with other offers.
Cash bonus may be considered interest reportable on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Field of membership: anyone who lives, works, worships, volunteers, or attends school in Monmouth and Ocean County (NJ).

Return the coupon to First Financial's Marketing Department.
Your friend opens a new membership ($5 Base Savings deposit) plus a new checking account between 2/17/26 and 12/31/26, subject to approval and identity verification.
Your $90 referral bonus is automatically deposited into your Base Savings Account at your friend's new account opening.
